mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.region, u.nickname AS report_by_name, COALESCE(t.item_count, 0) AS item_count, COALESCE(t.sell_total, 0) AS sell_total, COALESCE(t.stock_total, 0) AS stock_total FROM scm_channel_report r JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.report_by LEFT JOIN ( SELECT report_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(sell_qty) AS sell_total, SUM(stock_qty) AS stock_total FROM scm_channel_report_item GROUP BY report_id ) t ON t.report_id = r.id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_channel_report_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY m.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_channel_report_item (report_id, material_id, sell_qty, stock_qty) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.sellQty}, #{i.stockQty})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_price_list p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE (p.customer_level IS NULL OR p.customer_level = #{level}) AND (p.valid_from IS NULL OR p.valid_from <= #{date}) AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to >= #{date}) AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY m.code, CASE WHEN p.customer_level IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.min_qty
SELECT dept_id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId}
